title: Company snapshot
text: Space42 is a UAE-based, AI-powered SpaceTech company integrating satellite communications, geospatial insights, and artificial intelligence capabilities for customers globally. It operates through two business units: Space Services and Smart Solutions.

title: Business units
text: Space42 lists two business units: (1) Space Services and (2) Smart Solutions. Candidates can use this to understand whether a role is closer to satellite connectivity/space services or geospatial + AI solutions.

title: Origin and listing
text: Space42 states it was created as a result of the merger between Bayanat and Yahsat, and it is listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX).

title: Scale metrics (company-published)
text: On its About page, Space42 highlights company-published scale metrics including $629M FY 2024 revenue and 150+ countries covered by its satellite network.

title: Leadership visibility
text: Space42 publicly lists its Board of Directors and leadership team on its About page (names and roles). For official leadership details, refer to the About page.

title: Where to apply
text: Apply to Space42 roles via the official Space42 careers portal hosted on the G42 careers platform. Job listings and role details are maintained there.

title: Career themes: global impact
text: The Space42 careers site highlights 'Global Impact'—collaboration on projects addressing global challenges (e.g., disaster response to next-generation connectivity).

title: Career themes: growth
text: The Space42 careers site highlights 'Career Growth' and references learning and development opportunities to accelerate professional journeys.

title: Career themes: flexible work
text: The Space42 careers site highlights a 'Flexible Work Environment' and mentions 'hybrid working options'. Actual working patterns can vary by role/team/location.

title: Career themes: diversity and culture
text: The Space42 careers site emphasizes a 'Diverse & Inclusive Culture' and notes that a sense of mutual respect and mindfulness is key to success.

title: Talent community (stay in touch)
text: Candidates who are not ready to apply can join Space42’s Talent Community to hear about new opportunities when they open.

title: Hiring process (safe public description)
text: Space42’s public careers pages do not publish a single universal interview loop for every role. A safe general description: apply via the official portal; if shortlisted, recruiting contacts you with next steps (screening/interviews/assessments) depending on role and business needs; timelines vary.

title: Contact details (official channels)
text: Space42 publishes official contact details including HQ address in Abu Dhabi and general contact email/phone. Candidates can use these for general enquiries when appropriate.

title: Privacy policy purpose
text: Space42’s Privacy Policy explains how and why Space42 may collect, store, use, and/or share information when you visit the site or use services, and states that using the site indicates agreement to the policy and applicable terms.

title: Privacy policy: data collection overview
text: Space42’s Privacy Policy describes personal information collection when you interact with the site/services, including information you provide and information collected automatically (e.g., via cookies/trackers and technical device/browser data).

title: Privacy policy: children under 18
text: Space42’s Privacy Policy includes a children's privacy section stating it does not knowingly collect personal information from children under 18 and provides guidance to contact Space42 if such data is believed to have been collected.

title: Terms of Use: acceptable use and restrictions
text: Space42’s Terms of Use outline rules for using the website, including restrictions on copying/monitoring/scraping content and general 'as-is' / disclaimer language. Refer to the Terms for the full acceptable-use rules.

title: Press releases: where to find public updates
text: Space42 publishes a press release page with dated announcements about partnerships, initiatives, and milestones. Use it for public examples of work, not as a promise of team assignments.

title: G42 company page positioning
text: G42’s public company page describes Space42 as AI-powered space intelligence and notes it is listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange, operating globally.
